title: navigator-configurations-creating-event.html
content: Event Organizers must complete a few extra steps to prep the {{variable.Object_Event}} record and {{variable.Product_BlackthoEventNavigator}} app. Enable the Navigator app on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record by setting the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_EV_EnableNavigaAttMobApp}} field to “True” (checked). Configure the navigation features on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record, including hiding or relabeling navigation items. Upload PDFs of maps, {{variable.Object_Event}} documentation, and {{variable.Object_Session}} documentation to the {{variable.Object_EventContent}} record. Event Record Add the Blackthorn Event Navigator App to an Event Enabling or checking the {{variable.Field_EV_EnableNavigaAttMobApp}} field allows {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s to use the Navigator app during an {{variable.Object_Event}} . Disabling the Event Navigator App Unchecking the {{variable.Field_EV_EnableNavigaAttMobApp}} field will automatically delete the Navigator app link from Attendee records. Please proceed with caution. Contact Us Email Configure the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field to render the Contact Us page in the app. Open the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} field. Enter the email address of the person who will receive the emails. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Add the Push Notifications Component If you already added the BT Event Scheduler component (Smart Scheduler) to the Event record under the Communication tab, you do not need to add it again. Open an Event record. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click Edit Page . Click the Tabs section of the page layout. Click Add Tab . Click the new tab. It should be located at the bottom of the list of tabs. Click the {{variable.Field_SF_TabLabel}} field and select "Custom." Enter "Push Notifications" in the {{variable.Field_SF_CustomLabel}} field. Click {{variable.Button_Done}} . In the Tabs section on the page layout, tap the Push Notifications tab. In the Components column on the left side of the screen, enter "BT Event Scheduler." Drag and drop the BT Event Scheduler component onto the Push Notifications tab. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Event Settings Record Configure the Event Navigator App Depending on your {{variable.Object_Event}} , you may not need all of the features and navigation options in the Navigator app. The {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record has five fields in the new Attendee Mobile App section that can either show or hide corresponding sections in the app. {{variable.Field_EventSettings_ShowAgenda}} - Shows or hides the Agenda tab in the navigation bar. {{variable.Field_EVSettings_ShowAttendees}} - Shows or hides the Attendees tab in the navigation bar. {{variable.Field_EventSettings_ShowMap}} - Shows or hides the Info tab’s Get Directions (Google Map) button. {{variable.Field_EventSettings_ShowTicket}} - Shows or hides the Ticket tab in the navigation bar. {{variable.Field_EventSetting_ShowProfile}} - Shows or hides an individual Attendee’s profile screen. Data Dictionary Event Organizers with the Blackthorn | Events (Organizer) permission set can also use the Data Dictionary to rename the following section titles: Agenda, Attendees, Map, Ticket, Profile, Info, and Contact Us. Use the Keys in the table below when creating the Data Dictionary Entry. Once the Data Dictionary Group is complete, add it to the Event Setting’s {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DataDictGrp}} field. Section Title Key Agenda LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_AGENDA Attendees LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_ATTENDEES Map LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_MAP Ticket LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_TICKET Profile LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_PROFILE Info LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_OVERVIEW Contact Us LBL_PASSPORT_SECTION_CONTACT_US Click here for more information about creating a Data Dictionary Group and Data Dictionary Entries. Event Content Record Prerequisite: To ensure Event Content is visible, please set the Event Settings {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Venue}} field to “Always.” An existing issue causes Event Content to be hidden if the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Venue}} field is set to “Hidden.” When you create an {{variable.Object_Event}} , you can add PDF documents to the {{variable.Field_EVContent_DispNavigatApp}} field on an Event Content record. Please note: All PDF documents live at the {{variable.Object_Event}} level and cannot be tied to a specific Session. Attendee Records Event Organizers can include an automatically generated Attendee-specific Navigator invite and login link (deeplink) in Attendee communications. The personal invitation link is generated for each registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} when the app is enabled for the {{variable.Object_Event}} and is stored on an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s record in the {{variable.Field_Attendee_PerNavigAppLink}} field. While the Navigator app link is sent to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s like the AttendeeLink, each link has a different purpose. AttendeeLink: a unique link that welcomes {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s, invites them to register for an {{variable.Object_Event}} , and allows them to modify their free Session status. Event Navigator Link: a unique link that invites {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s to download the {{variable.Product_BlackthoEventNavigator}} app for use during a multi-session {{variable.Object_Event}} . The following must occur for the automatically generated Navigator login links can be created. The {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s {{variable.Field_EV_EnableNavigaAttMobApp}} field is checked. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to “Registered.” The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Email}} field contains an email address. Whether the app is enabled before or after an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for the {{variable.Object_Event}} , the Navigator login link will be generated and saved in the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_PerNavigAppLink}} field. If the Navigator app is not enabled for an {{variable.Object_Event}} , links will not be created for the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. When a Navigator login link is generated, it will include the 18-character Org ID format (full Salesforce Org ID). A URL in the following pattern will then be available in the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_PerNavigAppLink}} field: “https://app.navigator.blackthorn.io/?email=XXXXX&orgId=YYYY” You can now include the URL as a clickable link in an {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} or other Attendee communications.
